articles.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
articles.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
articles.description: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

articles.title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
articles.description: Pte William Douglas Dal Bianco died from his injuries on Friday, a month after a fire that tore through CFB Wainwright.

articles.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
articles.description: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

articles.title: US asked if Ukraine would give up parts of Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskyy says
articles.description: The US has asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region if Kyiv were admitted to NATO, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Hamas says senior commander killed in Israeli airstrike
articles.description: A senior Hamas commander who helped plan and oversee the 7 October 2023 attack had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, according to the Palestinian militant group.

articles.title: Goalkeeper given 12-game ban for fatal collision with Tenerife striker
articles.description: Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 games after an on-field collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, health ministry says
articles.description: An Israeli airstrike on a Palestinian hospital has killed at least six and wounded 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
